name: San Francisco Public Utilities Commission: Southeast WPCP, North Point WWF and Bayside wet-weather facilities
receiving_waters: San Francisco Bay (Central Basin, Islais Creek, Mission Creek, Yosemite Creek, Candlestick Cove, Marina)
outfalls_source: EPA National CSO Inventory (data/outfalls-us.json via research/ca/federal-seed.json)
notification_channel: SFPUC beach map flag 'Combined Sewer Discharge has occurred within the last 24-72 hours' (webapps.sfpuc.org/sapps/beachesandbay.html; JSON at infrastructure.sfwater.org/lims.asmx/getBeaches); signs at beaches; hotline 1-877-SFBEACH; email alerts offered
notes: SFPUC also files SSO spill reports to CIWQS (WDID 2SSO10193): 62 Category 2, 23 monthly Category 3, 1 Category 1 since 2023. EPA and the US sued the City over CSO discharges (search_only).
